license_summary: Public domain according to every Commons file page. Faces PD-old-70-expired / Public Domain Mark; back PD-US-expired / PD-UK (designer unknown, possibly Pamela Colman Smith).
back_design_label: 1909 original Roses & Lilies blue-and-white back; one historic classic design, not the only classic RWS back.
transformations: Aspect-preserving resize to 150px width, WebP quality 42 method 6; no redraw, recolouring, generative editing, or additional cropping. The Commons back source is a rotated/cropped scan.

mirror_provenance: Some source images downloaded from Arcanebra, whose methodology lists the same 78 Commons filenames and identifies the same 1909 Roses & Lilies first-print scans; actual download URLs recorded per file.
visual_verification: All 78 faces checked in an engine-card-ID-labelled contact sheet; original blue-and-white Roses & Lilies back viewed separately. Correct Strength VIII / Justice XI, four suits, and page/knight/queen/king mappings.
